intent: Add an immutable, hash-pinned SADHANA campaign agent-roster boundary that validates one exact seven-family zero-cash manifest, reconciles all stable names before effects, idempotently instantiates only missing exact AgentStates through SwarmManager, and returns actual runtime identities for the separately owned authority binder. A catalog observation is eligibility evidence only; useful work and completion still require owner execution plus independent acceptance.

negative_controls.name: identity-conflict-and-catalog-drift-denials
negative_controls.command: /Users/dhyana/dharma_swarm/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_mission_control_roster.py -k 'wrong_digest or duplicate_live_name or mismatched_live_identity or model_absent_from_catalog or expired or partial_spawn_recovery'

commit.message: feat(control): bind current SADHANA model roster

details: scripts/runtime/mission_control_campaign.py and tests/test_mission_control_campaign.py are concurrently touched by the separately sealed exact-authority binder; this packet owns only roster loading/spawn composition and must restack after that packet before closeout.

interface_mismatches: SwarmManager fast boot creates a partly stale static crew; exact authority binding can only bind already-live AgentStates and must not silently treat a stable name as a current provider route.
Provider catalog membership is an observation at one time, not liveness, task execution, semantic usefulness, or acceptance.
AgentState ids are process-local and random; stable manifest names must resolve to exactly one actual id after init and before authority leases are minted.
A crash can occur after some roster seats spawn; restart must reconcile exact matches and spawn only missing seats without duplicate names.
honest_blockers: The roster cannot prove account quota, provider latency, model quality, or future catalog availability; live canaries remain required.
All seven seats currently use one zero-cash Ollama account transport, so provider-family diversity is one even though model-family diversity is seven.
This packet does not activate or impersonate Hermes gateways; Mac, Megh, and AGNI Hermes processes remain separately owned A2A participants.
Instantiation does not grant task or effect authority; the separate exact authority manifest and file-backed lease verifier remain mandatory.
No task result is promoted by roster membership, spawn success, heartbeat, or model self-report.
session_entry.rollback: Stop the campaign supervisor, omit the roster manifest arguments, and revert this packet. Existing canonical TaskBoard and RuntimeStateStore rows remain untouched; process-local roster agents disappear on shutdown and no provider credential or external endpoint is modified.
